verdict.rationale: Gram surfaces some quality-relevant signals for the servers it governs — an initialize/liveness 'Verify' probe before a server is registered (gram-docs-14), deployment status history (gram-docs-18), usage metrics like tool calls/agent sessions (gram-docs-25), and risk findings/policy monitors (gram-docs-26, gram-docs-27) — which developers could use to gauge server health and trust. However, there's no evidence of a comparison view, aggregated quality scores, or verification badges across catalog entries (e.g. from the official MCP Registry import) that would let a developer directly compare multiple servers side-by-side. Missing for 10: an explicit cross-server comparison/scoring UI, verification badges tied to registry-sourced servers, and independent corroboration of these signals in practice.
